description: This file defines an abstract class 'PlotAreaRenderer' used as a base class for rendering plot areas in a charting component, including methods for initializing line and fill formats and setting default styling.

classes.name: PlotAreaRenderer
classes.description: An abstract class serving as the base for all plot area rendering classes in the charting module, providing initialization routines and styling defaults.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes and returns a RendererInfo object with plot area data, including setting line and fill formats.

methods.name: InitLineFormat
methods.description: Initializes the line format for the plot area, setting default values if necessary.

methods.name: InitFillFormat
methods.description: Initializes the fill format for the plot area, setting default values if necessary.
